note: Mongolia: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90, 30, 21 or 14 days (many of the 30-day exemptions a temporary policy to 1 January 2027); Indians, Kuwaitis and Qataris may take a visa on arrival at Chinggis Khaan airport for 30 days; nationals on the e-Visa list apply online, taken here for every other passport (its exclusions aren't in the source read). Ukrainians' 90 days with a voucher aren't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Immigration Agency's own e-Visa portal, whose lists of visa-free and e-Visa countries give no lengths and still carry a Covid-19 notice: they agree on most of the visa-free countries, but put Colombia, South Korea, Türkiye and Hong Kong on the e-Visa list, leave out the United Arab Emirates, and put Ukraine among the visa-free. The portal predates the temporary exemptions to 1 January 2027 that Wikipedia's copy records, so its lists are recorded here and not held; every figure stands on Wikipedia's copy.
